title: Pet-Friendly 4BR Rental in Rosemary Beach with Beach Access
meta_description: Spacious, pet-friendly 4BR, 4.5BA Gulfside home in Rosemary Beach features gulf views, a chef’s kitchen, and private beach access. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love · 4 Free Beach Cruiser Bikes included with every stay · Pet-Friendly — fully gated courtyard · Private boardwalk leads straight to the Gulf · Slight Gulf views from the top-floor balcony · Professional cook’s kitchen — new appliances, updated throughout · Private cobblestone parking pad — fits up to 4 vehicles · Sonos sound system, Apple TV & Universal Remote throughout · 3 separate HVAC systems — one per floor for personalized comfortWake up steps from the Gulf at Villa Rose Cottage — Rosemary Beach four-bedroom Southern charmer where a private boardwalk through the dunes is your daily path to turquoise water and white sand. Whether you're grilling in the gated cobblestone courtyard, uncorking a bottle at the wet bar, or cruising 30A on one of the four included beach bikes, this home is built for the kind of trip your family talks about for years.Home Layout1st Floor · King Primary Suite 1: Private bath with shower, private door to screened porch & side yard · King Primary Suite 2: Private bath with shower, private door to screened porch & side yard · Queen Guest Suite: Private bath with shower, private door to screened porch & side yard2nd Floor · Open living room with HDTV and Sonos system · Professional chef's kitchen with new appliances · Formal dining area · Wet bar with wine cooler · Half bath3rd Floor · Suite 4: 2 queen beds + 2 twin beds, private bath with tub/shower · Sitting area with entertainment center, high-speed WiFi & Gulf views — perfect for kidsOutdoor· Screened porch with private door access from all 1st-floor suites· Side yard for a pet· Gas Grill· Fully gated cobblestone courtyard patio with gas grill· Private boardwalk through the dunes to the Gulf· Private cobblestone parking pad — fits up to 4 vehicles· 4 beach cruiser bikes included with every stayGood to Know· Pets must be pre-approved; $200 pet fee applies· Parking for up to 4 vehicles on a private pad· 3 independent HVAC systems (one per floor)Rosemary Beach Community Amenities· Four community pools, including the iconic beachside Coquina infinity pool· Nine private beach walkovers — community-only access to powdery white sand· Eight clay Har-Tru tennis courts (additional Rosemary Beach fee applies)· Full fitness center (additional Rosemary Beach fee applies)· Cobblestone town center with acclaimed restaurants: Ambrosia, Paradis, Pescado, and more· Gas-lit pathways and boardwalk trails connecting every corner of the community· Year-round heated Sky Pool with lap lanes· Vivo Day Spa & Salon steps from your door· Barrett Square events, live music, and community programmingSTR-030156TDT-030156
